# Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite

Public front door: https://suite.kineticgain.com/
Source and architecture: https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-protocol-suite
Public repository index: https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mizcausevic-dev/blob/main/docs/REPOSITORIES.md

The Suite publishes twelve open JSON governance specifications. The eleven
regulated-vertical 6-packs are related extension repositories, not additional
tools inside the published unified MCP package.

## Start here

- Specs and links to each source repo: https://suite.kineticgain.com/specs/
- Related implementation repos and their release boundaries: https://suite.kineticgain.com/implementations/
- Unified MCP server: https://suite.kineticgain.com/mcp/
- Optional audit-stream architecture: https://suite.kineticgain.com/audit-stream/
- Selected properties: https://suite.kineticgain.com/properties/
- Regulated-vertical extensions: https://suite.kineticgain.com/verticals/

## Published MCP package

As checked on 2026-10-10, mcp-kinetic-gain v0.10.0 is published on npm with
provenance and listed in the official MCP Registry. It exposes 75 tools in one
local stdio MCP server: 47 spec tools, 16 implementation previews, 8 DefenseTech
tools, and 4 AI Claims Decision Card tools. Pin mcp-kinetic-gain@0.10.0 in a
client configuration rather than depending on a moving latest version.

- Source: https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain
- npm version: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mcp-kinetic-gain/v/0.10.0
- Official Registry record: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.mizcausevic-dev%2Fmcp-kinetic-gain/versions/latest

The published stdio tools validate, inspect, compare, and preview from supplied
data. A true allow result is not a downstream authorization grant. URL fetch
tools may contact user-supplied public origins. Optional live audit calls require
both AUDIT_STREAM_URL and AUDIT_STREAM_TOKEN for an approved sink. Chain
verification proves continuity among accepted events, not completeness.

A separate signed-card, one-tool HTTP pilot remains a draft source change at
https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain/pull/48. It is not in the
published npm package or Registry release. Buyer identity, authoritative
conditions, durable revocation, a private hosted boundary, independent audit
checkpoint, and hosted rollback remain unverified.

## Other boundaries

The visualizer's latest verified detector supports eleven Suite document types;
the published MCP server covers twelve. See
https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-visualizer.

The Suite implementation pages describe reference software and proposed
cross-repo integrations. A source link or local test does not establish live
provider behavior, a complete audit trail, or production enforcement. Inspect
each repository and its deployment evidence before relying on a claim.

Author: Miz Causevic, Kinetic Gain LLC
